Galician

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin aspectus.

Noun

[edit]

aspecto m (plural aspectos)

  1. appearance, look
  2. aspect

Latin

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • adspectō

Etymology

[edit]

From aspiciō (“look at, see”) +‎ -tō.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Classical Latin) IPA(key): [asˈpɛk.toː]
  • (modern Italianate Ecclesiastical) IPA(key): [asˈpɛk.to]

Verb

[edit]

aspectō (present infinitive aspectāre, perfect active aspectāvī, supine aspectātum); first conjugation

  1. to look at attentively; observe, watch, regard
  2. to look at with respect or desire; pay attention to
  3. to look or lie towards, overlook

Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • aspeto (Portugal)
  • aspeito (obsolete)

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin aspectus; displaced aspeito, from Old Galician-Portuguese aspeito.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /asˈpɛk.tu/, /asˈpɛ.ki.tu/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /asˈpɛk.tu/, /asˈpɛ.ki.tu/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /aʃˈpɛk.tu/, /aʃˈpɛ.ki.tu/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /asˈpɛk.to/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐʃˈpɛ.ktu/

  • Audio (Portugal (Porto)):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɛktu
  • Hyphenation: as‧pec‧to

Noun

[edit]

aspecto m (plural aspectos)

  1. appearance, look
  2. aspect

Usage notes

[edit]

The forms aspecto and aspeto are both used in Portugal, with aspeto being more common. In Brazil, only the form aspecto is used.

Further reading

[edit]
  • “aspecto”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “aspecto”, in Dicionário inFormal (in Portuguese), 2006–2026
  • “aspecto” in Dicionário Aberto based on Novo Diccionário da Língua Portuguesa de Cândido de Figueiredo, 1913
  • “aspecto”, in Dicionário infopédia da Lingua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Porto: Porto Editora, 2003–2026
  • “aspecto”, in Michaelis Dicionário Brasileiro da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), São Paulo: Editora Melhoramentos, 2015–2026, →ISBN
  • “aspecto”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin aspectus.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /asˈpeɡto/ [asˈpeɣ̞.t̪o]
  • Audio (Latin America):(file)
  • Rhymes: -eɡto
  • Syllabification: as‧pec‧to

Noun

[edit]

aspecto m (plural aspectos)

  1. aspect
  2. appearance, look
    Synonyms: apariencia, semblante

Derived terms

[edit]
  • aspectado

Related terms

[edit]
  • aspectual
